text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! I heard you're a good<n>drawer! The
Demon Queen Windy<n>orders you to draw me and
my<n>minions!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You'd better make us look extra cool<n>and evil!
'Cause it's goin' up on the<n>wall in my room, got
it?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...How am I supposed to sleep like<n>this?! I can't
believe I got a req from<n>one of my favs!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And she called me a "good drawer"!<n>That's like the
highest praise a<n>fanartist could ever get! I'm
throwing<n>my whole heart into the pic first thing
tomorrow morning!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh... ♪ What kind of pose should Idraw them in? The Demon Queen...and her loyal servants...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Rise again, Minion #2!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Kyaa! The MOE! I can't sleep onthis!!! AaaAAAAadfhgk, thanks formy lifeee!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You, you did it! With this new undead<n>servant,
you're one step closer to<n>your nefarious goals, my
liege.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwhaha! Let's go and fill the world<n>with devilish
deeds! C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Go forth, Dot-o'-Lantern! Jiangshi! I<n>expect you to
bring back trick-or-treat<n>hauls worthy of your
queen!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Anything for you, my queeeen! I loveyouuu! You can trick me any tiiime!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what the heck are you doing?!<n>Quit gushing
and go be evil!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, r-right! Sorry! You were so radiant,<n>I couldn't
help myself!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Well, y-you're still new to being a<n>villain. It's, um,
it's completely normal<n>to make a few mistakes
while you're<n>learning...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Like I care about that! C'mon, you<n>dumb idiots!
You're MY minions, so<n>act like it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Guwaaah! You're too cute when<n>you're angry
omgomgaaaaadsdhk<n>help no omg my heart aaa I
CAAAN'T! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: WHOA?! Why'd she drop deadagain?! I just raised that moron!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eep! M-my liege, please! I beg your<n>forgiveness!
I-I'm sure she just<n>needs a little time to adjust,
that's all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: SHUT UP! I don't care—that stupidfangirl's gettin' chomped!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Creeeak... Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah?! My queen, watch ouuut!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeep?! T-the sign fell right on her!<n>The poor
jiangshi...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
She sacrificed herself to push me out<n>of the way...
Hey. I said HEY!<n>W-wake up! C'mon...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My liege... Are you... o...kay?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What are you, stupid?! Why are youworried about me? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I was gonna give you a chomping,<n>but... Urrrgh,
forget it! I don't feel like<n>biting you anymore!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Be-because you're dumb and<n>annoying, I mean!
I'm not crying!<n>Why would I be sad you got hurt?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: My liege... Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I hear voices echoing in the<n>darkness... How
tragically beautiful...<n>Oh nooo, they sound so sweet!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uraaaaaah! This is no time to be lying<n>around dead!
I've got simping to do!

text_block_list.name: Queen & Lantern
text_block_list.text: Y-you! Jiangshiiiii!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My liege! Doto! Look, I'm right as<n>rain! You don't
need to worry about<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So please put some smiles back on<n>your beautiful
faces! I need my oshis<n>to be happy—it's literally life
or death!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I don't even know what to<n>make of you
anymore. But if you're<n>alive, then get up and do
your job!<n>C'mon, we're leaving!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...And that's when I woke up. What a<n>dream, right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I just wish it hadn't been quite soself-insert-y. Like I could neverinteract with my oshis like that! Andjust imagine what they might'vedone if I'd been a ghost and they hadno idea I was watching!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...You weren't as useless as I<n>thought. I won't
forget your sacrifice.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'll treat my other<n>minion better. I'll
give her the care I<n>wasn't able to give you. B-but
just a<n>little!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dot-o'-Lantern! Quit crying<n>already! You've
still got me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: My... My liege!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It'll all be okay. We can still spread<n>evil—just the
two of us. So... so shut<n>up and follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Of course! I, um... I know I'm not<n>the most
reliable, but I promise I'll do<n>my very best for you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (What a beautiful pair... My heart<n>feels... so free...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A wisp of light just... le-left the<n>jiangshi's
body?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...And there she goes, ascending into<n>the sky. Her
body's got such a<n>peaceful smile on its face...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...And that's when I woke up. What a<n>dream, right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I just wish it hadn't been quite soself-insert-y. Like I could neverinteract with my oshis like that! Andjust imagine what they might'vedone if I'd been a ghost and they hadno idea I was watching!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Uwaaaaaah! You dumb,stupid idiooot!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...My liege. Are you feeling a little<n>better now?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. That jiangshi... She was a<n>weirdo, but she
wasn't bad.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So for her sake, I've gotta pull myself<n>together and
be strong!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! Let's conquer the world and<n>fill it with fear!
It's what she would<n>have wanted.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Right behind you! I'm sure the<n>jiangshi is
watching us from her<n>grave with a smile!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I see the two of them run into the<n>distance, side by
side. There for each<n>other, together evermore...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...And that's when I woke up. What a<n>dream, right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I just wish it hadn't been quite soself-insert-y. Like I could neverinteract with my oshis like that! Andjust imagine what they might'vedone if I'd been a ghost and they hadno idea I was watching!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But still, it definitely gave me somegood material! It was the perfectinspiration for Windy's picture!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whiiich I've gotta go offer up to her<n>Demonic
Majesty! I'll catch you<n>later, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the sound of it, she's had a fun<n>Halloween
season, and that's what<n>counts!
